title: geo_restriction plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `geo_restriction` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component GeoRestrictionConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

GeoRestrictionConfig.description: Plugin: geo_restriction — country-level access control backed by a MaxMind GeoIP2 / GeoLite2 `.mmdb` file. The database is fully verified and loaded into bounded owned immutable memory at construction. Files larger than 512 MiB, aggregate verified MMDB content above 512 MiB per validation generation/cache build, and records containing unsupported country codes are rejected before publication. File dependency validation is fatal in file mode and warns for absent/unreadable files in database mode. CP performs structure-only validation without opening node-local files; DP validates and refreshes its node-local files for full snapshots and affected incremental rebuilds. On runtime nodes that construct the plugin, a missing file uses `on_lookup_failure`, while a readable corrupt, incompatible, or wrong-product database is rejected. Exactly one of `allow_countries` and `deny_countries` must be non-empty. Runs on every protocol — HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, TCP, UDP. Every evaluated request or stream session records the log-allowlisted metadata `geo.decision` (`allowed`, `country_not_allowed`, `country_denied`, `lookup_failed_allowed`, `lookup_failed_denied`, `db_not_loaded_allowed`, `db_not_loaded_denied`) and, when a country was resolved, `geo.country`.

db_path.description: Filesystem path to a MaxMind GeoIP2 or GeoLite2 `.mmdb` database no larger than 512 MiB. Across one validation generation/cache build, the verified sizes of all distinct content snapshots must also total no more than 512 MiB; equivalent path spellings with identical verified content are charged once. A changed candidate overlaps the live snapshot; when their combined size exceeds 512 MiB, hot replacement is rejected and the installed database must be loaded by restarting the gateway. Required.

allow_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (case-insensitive — normalized to uppercase) that are allowed. Mutually exclusive with `deny_countries`. Example: `["US", "CA", "GB"]`.

deny_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (case-insensitive — normalized to uppercase) that are denied. Mutually exclusive with `allow_countries`.

inject_headers.description: When true, inject the resolved country code into the proxied request as the `x-geo-country` header (uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Central header materialization strips any client-supplied value even when no geo plugin is attached. The header remains absent on fail-open lookup paths unless an earlier geo instance already emitted an authoritative value; later non-injecting instances preserve that value. HTTP-family proxies only — ignored on TCP/UDP streams.

on_lookup_failure.description: Action when the client IP cannot be resolved to a country. Applies to both genuine MaxMind misses (private IPs, unallocated ranges) and to the data plane fallback path when the `.mmdb` file is missing on disk. The default `allow` is fail-open: unresolved traffic is permitted, so a missing or stale `.mmdb` silently disables the geo gate. Set this explicitly to `deny` for fail-closed behaviour. When the default is used, a one-time warning is logged at startup, and the first request-time fail-open is logged at warn.

GeoRestrictionCountryCode.description: A currently assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or XK (the user-assigned Kosovo code emitted by MaxMind). Matching is case-insensitive and runtime storage is normalized to uppercase. Other reserved, user-assigned, deleted, and alias codes are rejected.
